Name: Transport Framework
Author: mouahrara
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TransportFramework/images/main.jpg[/img]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TransportFramework/images/scrolls/01.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using [b]SMAPI[/b].[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]This mod doesn't do anything on its own; you need to install content packs separately.[/b][/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TransportFramework/images/scrolls/02.png[/img]

[size=3][b]To use this framework, you need to install a Transport Framework content pack.[/b] These content packs add new destinations to the base game's transport networks (Minecart, Bus, Boat, Parrot Express) or create new transport networks with their own destinations.[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TransportFramework/images/scrolls/03.png[/img]

[size=3]The Transport Framework content packs allow you to add transport stations to the base game's transport networks or create your own transport networks without any programming. Refer to the [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/TransportFramework/wiki]mod author documentation[/url] for more information.[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TransportFramework/images/scrolls/04.png[/img]

[size=3]English and French translations are included in the base mod, and contributions are welcome. To contribute, please submit a pull request on the [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/TransportFramework/pulls]GitHub repository[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TransportFramework/images/scrolls/05.png[/img]

[size=3]Transport Framework is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.0+ on Linux/Mac/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TransportFramework/images/scrolls/06.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/mouahrara/TransportFramework/releases]Release notes[/url][/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/mouahrara/TransportFramework]Source code[/url][/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/190812873?tab=user+files]My other mods[/url][/size]
[/list]
[size=2][i]Endorse and vote for this mod if you like it! Thank you for your support![/i][/size]
